cohort: 1793 adolescent pregnant women (1051 Turkish and 742 Syrian refugees)
finding: Refugee adolescent pregnant women had higher rates of adolescent pregnancy, anemia, and low birth weight newborns, but lower maternal age at delivery, preeclampsia rates, and cesarean delivery rates compared to Turkish adolescent pregnant women.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were lower in refugee adolescent pregnant women compared to Turkish adolescent pregnant women (p=0.02).
